name: lifecycle-engine
description: A lifecycle marketing operating layer for Claude: deliverability diagnosis and sending gates, behavioral activation and win-back flows, copy in the right template dialect for Braze, Customer.io, Klaviyo, HubSpot and Salesforce Marketing Cloud, warehouse SQL for RFM, LTV and retention in Snowflake, BigQuery and PostgreSQL, and experiment sizing and holdout readouts that separate attributed from incremental revenue. It includes a teammate that turns a plain-English campaign brief into a build-ready plan, and, new in 2.2, a resumable Analyst, Strategist, Copywriter, QA and Compliance pipeline, one plain-English command (lcm) for the whole engine, live SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MTA-STS checks, engagement-tier suppression of unengaged cohorts, and a daily 05:00 UTC health job logged to Google Sheets.
